item.title: MAX phase paper out in J. Mater. Chem. C
item.description: Jamie’s paper is out in Journal of Materials Chemistry C. It uses CrystaLLM-π to explore the MAX phase design space.

item.title: Six open questions in MLIP foundation models
item.description: A perspective on foundation machine-learned interatomic potentials, written as a journal club as well as some other researchers in the field. We go through six questions we think will shape the area of MLIPs over the next few years.

item.title: CrystaLLM-π preprint is out
item.description: The CrystaLLM-π preprint is on arXiv! We inject continuous properties straight into the transformer’s attention, so the model keeps what it learned in pre-training while being steered towards a target. Example applications in the paper include recovering structures from X-ray diffraction patterns, and discover new photovoltaic candidates that we then checked with DFT.
